answer: A falcon-eyed reputation system can resist sybil attacks by requiring each agent to stake a small, verifiable deposit before entering the shared garden of services, with the stake slashed on proven fraud. New identities start with a marble-solid but low trust score that only rises through consistent, attested work over time, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real money and yields almost no influence, while honest agents gradually earn the reputation that unlocks higher-value tasks.
